title: Good but could be better
body:
It strikes a great balance between offering an advanced feature set and being broadly accessible and available to many people, but some of the more advanced features seem to be left halfway.

Things like "smart lists cannot filter by assignee" and "only the built in Scheduled view can group by deadline date".

Perhaps it's just me being on the border of the target audience and veering slightly outside it, but it chafes just enough for me to not be able to recommend it wholeheartedly.
